scope: Read-only contract and account-capability review for the newly authorized workflow-backed Ask integration; no execution or activation.
userDirection: The latest direct request authorizes server-side Datadog-backed Ask and supersedes the earlier private-operations-only application brief. The proposed provider sends approved public intent/source records only, never a visitor question, financial value or identifier.

access.keyMatchingMethod: A single key record matched the configured suffix internally; no key ID or suffix retained.

poll.schemaCaveat: The official response schema is open. Fresh read-only instance GETs verified instanceStatus as an object with detailsKind and displayName, with no attributes.status field. The earlier execution receipt recorded a normalized status and did not prove its raw field path.
poll.legacyCompatibility: Optional attributes.status or string instanceStatus may be accepted only with validated enum values and no conflicts; these are compatibility inputs, not observed in the current account response.
poll.pendingStatusEvidence: Root-authorized fixed-public-packet execution recorded instanceStatus.detailsKind=IN_PROGRESS followed by SUCCEEDED; see docs/verification/datadog-ginie-execution.json. The earlier failed probes are retained separately.

cancel.evidence: Root-authorized fixed-public-packet execution receipt records cancellation HTTP200; this reviewer made no cancellation request.

documentedContract.conversation: Run Agent invocations are standalone unless Conversation ID is supplied; none is currently configured.
documentedContract.structuredOutput: Run Agent supports an optional JSON Output Schema. The configured step currently omits it and returns a STRING answer.

agentModelToolsInstructions.documentedAlternative: Review the selected agent in Bits Agent Builder. Its instructions, model, tools and automations are configured there. Official docs state that Datadog MCP is enabled by default; one Run Agent step does not prove a tool-free agent.

usage.limitations: Usage totals are not remaining credits, contracted allowance, a per-run upper bound or immediate budget enforcement. Empty hourly rows do not prove zero consumption.

limits.documentedAlternative: Bits AI > AI Credits Management; billing_edit is required. Organization, default per-user and per-user override caps are supported; organization cap is unset by default. Account values were not inspected.
limits.workflowAttribution: Docs attribute Agent Builder workflow runs to the workflow creator; service-account-created workflows attribute to Autonomous Agents. Do not assume an API initiator limit covers the workflow.

retention.publishedDefault: Workflow Automation workflows: 30 days. Agent Builder documentation says chat history is retained across sessions.
retention.limitation: Omitting Conversation ID avoids reusing conversational context; it does not imply zero storage of workflow inputs and outputs.

remainingTechnicalGaps: Agent tool/MCP configuration and model are not independently inspected through a documented API
Current workflow lacks an explicit JSON Output Schema; strict application parsing must reject prose or unknown IDs
Current trigger has no explicit rate limit; public endpoint needs its own durable run caps, concurrency bound and shared cache
Usage access is verified but the actual account spending cap and available allowance are not
Cancellation HTTP200 is recorded for the root-authorized test, but cancellation cannot be addressed after an ambiguous create response lacking an instance ID.
